limitations: All price bars end on 2026-09-11; no 2026-09-12 intraday or incomplete bar is included.
The OHLCV series use raw provider closes because all eight local histories expose OHLCV but no adjusted-close field.
The local 60-return common window is available for HPE, DELL, NTAP, TSM, SMTC and QQQ only.
XLE, SOXX and GRID are excluded from the matrix: their local artifacts contain 37, 35 and 37 sessions respectively, below the requested 61 closes needed for 60 returns.

Fortum and Neste bars are present through 2026-09-11, but the acquisition artifact marks their venue-calendar completion as unavailable; their dates are retained without inferring an exchange-calendar certification.
The indexed ETF comparison uses only the 34 exact local dates common to XLE, SOXX, GRID and QQQ; no missing session is filled.

indexed_comparison.method: raw close indexed to 100 on the first common session; no interpolation
